modules.title: Introduction to Aha (Nouns)
modules.html:
Types of Igbo nouns, gender and number. This section covers introduction to aha (nouns).

Key points

  • Ole bụ ụdị aha (Types of Nouns) dị n'asụsụ Igbo — Isii.
  • Chọpụta aha pụrụ iche (Proper noun) n'ime ndị a: — Enugwu.
  • Olee aha nwa a mụrụ n'ụbọchị 'Eke' — Mgbeke.
  • Kedu aha a na-akpọ nwa mbụ nwoke mụrụ n'ezinụlọ — Diọpara.
  • Gịnị bụ aha mbụ onye malitere idepụta asụsụ Igbo — F.C. Ogbalu.

Worked examples

Q: Ole bụ ụdị aha (Types of Nouns) dị n'asụsụ Igbo?
A: Isii — Commonly, Igbo nouns are categorized into six types: Aha pụrụ iche, aha nkịtị, aha nnọchite, aha mkpokọta, aha njirimara, na aha agbatara n'aka.

Q: Chọpụta aha pụrụ iche (Proper noun) n'ime ndị a:
A: Enugwu — Enugwu is a specific name of a place, making it a proper noun.

quiz.q: Ole bụ ụdị aha (Types of Nouns) dị n'asụsụ Igbo?
quiz.solution: Commonly, Igbo nouns are categorized into six types: Aha pụrụ iche, aha nkịtị, aha nnọchite, aha mkpokọta, aha njirimara, na aha agbatara n'aka.

quiz.q: Chọpụta aha pụrụ iche (Proper noun) n'ime ndị a:
quiz.solution: Enugwu is a specific name of a place, making it a proper noun.

quiz.q: Olee aha nwa a mụrụ n'ụbọchị 'Eke'?
quiz.solution: Children are often named after the market day they were born. A girl born on Eke is 'Mgbeke'; a boy is 'Okeke'.

quiz.q: Kedu aha a na-akpọ nwa mbụ nwoke mụrụ n'ezinụlọ?
quiz.solution: 'Diọpara' (or Opwara) is the title for the first-born son in an Igbo family.

quiz.q: Gịnị bụ aha mbụ onye malitere idepụta asụsụ Igbo?
quiz.solution: F.C. Ogbalu is considered the father of modern Igbo language studies and promotion.

quiz.q: Aha nkejiasụsụ na-akọwa aha bụ _____.
quiz.solution: An adjective (Nkọwa) is a word that describes or qualifies a noun.

quiz.q: Aha obodo bụ 'Enugwu' dabara n'ụdị aha wo?
quiz.solution: Enugwu is a specific name of a place, so it is a proper noun (Aha pụrụ iche).

quiz.q: Ụdị aha 'Nwa' bụ _____.
quiz.solution: 'Nwa' (child) is a common noun (aha nkịtị).

quiz.q: Olee aha a na-akpọ nwa mbụ nwaanyị mụrụ n'ezinụlọ?
quiz.solution: The first-born daughter is known as 'Ada'.

quiz.q: Kedu aha akwụkwọ mbụ Chinua Achebe dere?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Things Fall Apart.

quiz.q: Kedu aha 'Nne'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Mother.

quiz.q: Gịnị bụ aha nwa nwaanyị mbụ n'ezinụlọ Igbo?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Ada.

quiz.q: Olee aha a na-akpọ nwa mbụ nwoke?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Opara.

quiz.q: Olee aha a na-akpọ 'Nigeria' n'asụsụ Igbo?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Naịjirịa.

quiz.q: Kedu aha a na-akpọ 'Sun' n'asụsụ Igbo?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Anyanwụ.

quiz.q: Kedu aha a na-akpọ 'Moon' n'Igbo?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Ọnwa.

quiz.q: Kedu aha a na-akpọ nwa e tere mmanụ (beloved child)?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: Nwa ite mmanụ.

quiz.q: Gịnị bụ 'Sky'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Elu igwe.

quiz.q: Gịnị bụ 'Work'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Ọrụ.

quiz.q: Kedu nke bụ 'Nkejiokwu'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Syllable.

quiz.q: Kedu nke bụ 'Ikuku'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Air/Wind.

quiz.q: Kedu nke bụ 'Akpụkpọ ụkwụ'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Shoe.

quiz.q: Menene ake kira da 'Wasali'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: Vowel.

quiz.q: Idan ana 'Sallah', ina ake kallo?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: Gabas (Ka'aba).

quiz.q: Menene ake nufi da 'Jinsi'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: Gender.

quiz.q: Wanne ne 'Ruwa'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: Water.

quiz.q: Olee akaraedemede a na-eji eme ajụjụ?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: ?.

quiz.q: Gịnị bụ 'Snake' n'asụsụ Igbo?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Agwọ.

quiz.q: Gịnị ka a na-akpọ 'Good night' n'asụsụ Igbo?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Ka chi fo.

quiz.q: Tụgharịa 'School' n'Igbo:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: Ụlọ akwụkwọ.

quiz.q: Kedu akwụkwọ akụkọ a maara ama nke Toni Ubesie dere?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: Juochi.

quiz.q: Gịnị bụ 'Five'?
quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2025). Correct answer: Ise.
